html:
The Sac and Fox Nation is a tribe of central Oklahoma, with its headquarters near Stroud. Its people descend from the Sauk and Meskwaki, Algonquian peoples of the western Great Lakes. The map shows the territory in 1492, but they arrived here only in 1869.

The Sauk and Fox lived around Green Bay and later on the Mississippi in Illinois and Iowa. After the Black Hawk War of 1832 they lost their land east of the Mississippi and were moved to Iowa, then Kansas, then Indian Territory. The athlete Jim Thorpe, Olympic champion in 1912, was a citizen of the Sac and Fox Nation. Other branches live in Iowa and on the Kansas and Nebraska border.
